title: Gulf Dead Zone More Than Doubled To 6,705 Square Miles
hook: A shrinking ocean dead zone suddenly surged back.
closing: Fertilizer runoff keeps stealing oxygen from Gulf sea life faster than cleanup can recover it.
question: Who should pay to reduce runoff?

segments.say: The Gulf dead zone reached 6,705 square miles, more than double its previous reading. The recovery reversed in one summer.
Its current average is 3,745 square miles, leaving the Gulf dead zone nearly twice the cleanup goal.
Gulf nitrogen load reached 300 percent of its earlier level, feeding algae that strips oxygen from the water.
